title: Dirichlet problem for Lane-Emden type equations with several sublinear terms
summary: We prove the existence, uniqueness, and sharp bilateral pointwise estimates for positive bounded solutions to the Lane--Emden type problem \[ \begin{cases} L u = \sum\limits_{i=1}^{m}σ_{i} u^{q_{i}}+σ_0, \quad u\geq0 & \text{in } Ω, \liminf \limits_{x \rightarrow y} u(x) = f(y), & y \in \partial^\inftyΩ, \end{cases} \] where $0 < q_{i} < 1$.
